description: Ministry of Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Disputes between K. W. W. M. B. M. G. K. B Wekadapola, Pannipitiya and Other Part Independent Television Network Ltd, Battaramulla (S and E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of legal/regulatory powers under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains an official order made by the Minister under Section 4(1) of the Act, appointing an arbitrator to settle an industrial dispute. The content focuses on legal procedures, statutory powers, and regulatory mechanisms for dispute resolution rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
